Default angle style wraps URLs containing spaces in angle brackets

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"/file (1).pdf\">file</a>", new ConversionOptions { UrlEscapeStyle = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<UrlEscapeStyle>("\"angle\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
